title: Tomorrow Reporting for Duty | Boston Dynamics
abstract:
Wherever you need an extra set of eyes or a helping hand, Spot is ready.

Today Spot is working with people and for people to make our jobs and our communities safer, more reliable, and more intelligent. See what tomorrow brings.

See Spot work: https://www.youtube.com/playlist?list=PLlL_rsmcRMZdfIb3ZQSsxTFREs0iPpQse 
Discover Physical Intelligence: https://www.youtube.com/playlist?list=PLlL_rsmcRMZftaIEVAUt2EJEZ0wPKVqXE
